title: Separable integer partition classes and Slater's list -- I
summary: Slater's list of Rogers-Ramanujan type identities consists of 130 series-product identities whose analytic proofs rely primarily on Bailey pair techniques. Although these identities play an important role in the theory of $q$-series and partitions, combinatorial interpretations for many of them remain unknown, largely because the series sides are difficult to interpret naturally in terms of partitions.
